name: Camp Merriwood
description_short: A traditional overnight camp for girls ages 8-15 in the foothills of the White Mountains in Orford, New Hampshire. It offers a 7-week full session, 4-week and 3-week half sessions, and 2-week "Splash of Magic" sessions for new younger campers.
